fakes:
kith-stub --lock-dir <HOME>/.kith/core/locks --key lc-st -- <HOME>/claude-fake -p --resume lc-st /compact
claude -p --resume lc-st /compact
claim held
state:home/claude-fake:
#!/bin/sh
# claude -p --resume SID /compact: logs the call and whether the writer claim file is there, then compacts (or fails, or waits).
sid=$3
printf 'claude %s\n' "$*" >> "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG"
[ -f "$KITH_STATE/live/terminal/$sid.claim" ] && echo "claim held" >> "$DIFFTEST_FAKELOG"
[ -f "$KITH_STATE/fail" ] && exit 1
now=<TS>
f=$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/p/$sid.jsonl
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"system","subtype":"compact_boundary","timestamp":"'$now'"}' \
  '{"type":"user","isCompactSummary":true,"timestamp":"'$now'","message":{"content":"This session is being continued..."}}' \
  '{"type":"user","timestamp":"'$now'","message":{"content":"<command-name>/compact</command-name>"}}' >> "$f"
